en-US.description: Offline push-to-talk dictation for Lithuanian, Russian and English - text appears in any program.
en-US.longDescription:
Hold the right Ctrl key, speak, release - the recognised text is typed into
whatever program has the cursor (Word, browser, chat, accounting software).
Speech recognition runs entirely on your own computer: audio and text never
leave it, there is no account and no subscription.
Lithuanian is recognised by Paprika, Kristijonas Jakubsonas' fine-tune of
whisper-large-v3-turbo trained on the LIEPA-3 corpus and published under an
open licence (7.6 % word error rate on LIEPA-derived test sets versus 26 %
for generic Whisper). Punctuation and capitalisation are restored
automatically; spoken Lithuanian numerals are converted to digits with the
right cases. Russian and English use the generic faster-whisper large-v3.
Choose one or two dictation languages during installation; the UI follows the
first one. Switch languages mid-dictation with the arrow keys while Ctrl is
held.
The installer is small (~180 MB). On first launch the program asks before
downloading the models it needs for the chosen languages (about 1.9 GB for
Lithuanian only, up to 5 GB for two languages). After that it works offline.
An NVIDIA GPU is detected automatically and CUDA libraries are offered as an
optional download; recognition then takes about 0.2 s per sentence, or a few
seconds on the CPU without a GPU.
Not signed with a paid certificate, so Windows SmartScreen shows a warning on
first run. The SHA-256 of every release file is published next to it.
en-US.name: Diktuokle
